=== Order ===
* {{BD|Strength}} is applied '''before''' multiplicative effects like {{BD|Vulnerable}}.
** For example, if you have 2 {{BD|Strength}} and play {{C|Strike (Ironclad)|Strike}} on a {{BD|Vulnerable}} target, you will deal '''12''' damage ((6+2)×1.5) instead of '''11''' damage ((6×1.5)+2).
** Multiplicative effects are {{BD|Vulnerable}}, {{BD|Weak}}, {{KW|Wrath}}, {{KW|Divinity}}, {{C|Phantasmal Killer}}, {{R|Pen Nib}}, {{BD|Slow}}, {{BD|Surrounded}} and {{R|Spear of Blight}}.

* {{BD|Vigor}}, {{C|Accuracy}}, {{R|Strike Dummy}} and {{R|Wrist Blade}} work exactly like {{BD|Strength}} and stack additively.

=== What works with Strength ===
* Damaging [[Relics]] and [[Orbs]] do not interact with {{BD|Strength}}.

* Only {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Attack|Attack}} cards can benefit from {{BD|Strength}}
** For example, {{C|Combust}}, {{C|Corpse Explosion}}, {{C|Electrodynamics}}, {{C|Omega}} and {{C|The Bomb}} do '''not''' work with {{BD|Strength}}.

* Direct removal of HP does not count as damage, and thus do not benefit from {{BD|Strength}}.
** The secondary effects of {{C|Hemokinesis}}, {{C|Poisoned Stab}} and {{C|Choke}} are completely unnafected by {{BD|Strength}}.

* Attacks that deal 0 damage, like {{C|Body Slam}} used with no {{KW|Block}}, will deal nonzero damage if you have {{BD|Strength}}.

=== Negative Strength ===
* Negative {{BD|Strength}}, {{BD|Strength Down}} and {{BD|Shackled}} are [[Debuffs]], and thus they can be blocked by {{BD|Artifact}} or removed with {{R|Orange Pellets}}.

* Losing {{BD|Strength}} is always treated as gaining a [[Debuff]], even if you would still end up with a positive value.

* Attacks that deal 0 damage will trigger on-attack effects like {{BD|Thorns}}, but not on-damage effects like {{BD|Malleable}}.

* {{BD|Strength}} is capped between -999 and 999.

{{Clear}}

== Hints ==
=== General ===
<!--
* '''''TODO''''' - Talk about multiplicative scaling from multiple sources.
** '''''TODO''''' - Don't put all eggs in the same basket, you don't need a billion strength to scale, a few points of strength combined with other sources of scaling is enough.
-->

* Expensive and slow sources of {{BD|Strength}}, like {{C|Demon Form}}, {{C|Reprogram}} and {{R|Shuriken}} tend to work better in long combats against [[Elites]] and [[Bosses]], but weak againt common [[Monsters]]. Because of this you should also include cheaper sources of {{BD|Strength}} for normal combats, like {{C|Inflame}}, {{R|Vajra}} and {{P|Strength Potion}}.
** Some sources of {{BD|Strength}}, like {{C|J.A.X.}}, are useful both in short and long combats.

=== Synergies ===
* Multiplicative sources of damage, like {{BD|Vulnerable}} and {{KW|Wrath}}, also multiplies the extra damage dealth with {{BD|Strength}}.

* Cards that hit multiple times will apply {{BD|Strength}} each hit. They are {{C|Heavy Blade}}, {{C|Sword Boomerang}}, {{C|Twin Strike}}, {{C|Pummel}}, {{C|Whirlwind}}, {{C|Fiend Fire}}, {{C|Bane}}, {{C|Blade Dance}}, {{C|Cloak and Dagger|Cloak and Dagger+}}, {{C|Dagger Spray}}, {{C|Endless Agony}}, {{C|Eviscerate}}, {{C|Finisher}}, {{C|Flechettes}}, {{C|Riddle with Holes}}, {{C|Skewer}}, {{C|Glass Knife}}, {{C|Storm of Steel}}, {{C|Barrage}}, {{C|Rip and Tear}}, {{C|Thunder Strike}}, {{C|Bowling Bash}}, {{C|Flying Sleeves}}, {{C|Carve Reality}}, {{C|Tantrum}}, {{C|Conjure Blade}} and {{C|Ragnarok}}.

* {{C|Reaper}} heals more with higher {{BD|Strength}}.

* {{C|Wallop}} {{KW|Block|blocks}} based on damage dealt.

* Damage-wise, 0-cost cards such as {{C|Anger}} and {{C|Just Lucky}} benefit from {{BD|Strength}} just as well as other Attacks, but their cheaper cost makes them able to apply the extra damage more often.

=== Making temporary effects permanent ===
* Temporary sources of {{BD|Strength}} like {{C|Flex}}, {{R|Mutagenic Strength}} and {{P|Flex Potion}} work by giving you {{BD|Strength}} plus an equal amount of {{BD|Strength Down}}. Since {{BD|Strength Down}} is a [[Debuff]], you can use {{BD|Artifact}} or {{R|Orange Pellets}} to remove it, keeping the gained {{BD|Strength}} permanently.
** {{BD|Artifact}} blocks each individual instance of {{BD|Strength Down}} gained, but can also prevent {{BD|Strength Down}} from working at the end of turn. Thus, if you have multiple {{P|Flex Potion|Flex Potions}}, it's better that you drink all of them '''before''' you gain {{BD|Artifact}}. This way you can block the {{BD|Strength Down}} of all potions combined with a single charge of {{BD|Artifact}}.

* Temporary sources of negative {{BD|Strength}} like {{C|Piercing Wail}} and {{C|Dark Shackles}} work by reducing {{BD|Strength}} then giving an equal amount of {{BD|Shackled}}. Since {{BD|Shackled}} is a [[Debuff]], it can be removed if applied on the same turn an enemy is removing debuffs, making the {{BD|Strength}} loss permanent.
** This trick works on {{M|The Champ}} using {{Int|The Champ|Anger}}, {{M|Awakened One}} using {{Int|Awakened One|Rebirth}} and {{M|Time Eater}} using {{Int|Time Eater|Haste}}.
** This does '''not''' work when {{M|Corrupt Heart}} is using {{Int|Corrupt Heart|Buff}}, because it doesn't remove debuffs, only negative {{BD|Strength}}. In fact, the {{M|Corrupt Heart}} will only end up ''stronger'' as the {{BD|Shackled}} remains while the negative {{BD|Strength}} doesn't.

== Achievements ==
=== JAXXED ===
* Unlocks when {{BD|Strength}} reaches '''50''' or more during combat.

It ends your turn, and skips every part of the enemy's turn, as well as the end of the round, bringing it immediately to the start of your turn again. == Interactions == === Order === * Anything that triggers, decreases or wears off at any part of your turn still functions as normal, for example: ** Your {{KW|Block}} is removed as normal. ** Any form of {{KW|Retain}}, such as through {{BD|Retain Cards|Well-Laid Plans}} or {{BD|Equilibrium}} triggers, as well as {{BD|Establishment}} reducing the cost of these {{KW|Retain|Retained}} cards. ** Effects such as {{BD|Double Tap}}, {{BD|Rebound}} and {{BD|Entangled}} wear off. ** You will lose {{BD|Strength}} or {{BD|Dexterity}} through effects such as {{BD|Strength Down}} or {{BD|Wraith Form}}. ** You will exit the Divinity {{KW|Stance}}. ** Damaging effects, such as {{BD|Omega}} or {{BD|The Bomb}} deal damage as normal. * Anything that triggers, decreases, wears off or resets at any point of the enemy's turn is skipped. ** Anything mentioned in the previous block is skipped if it belongs to an enemy instead of the player. ** Enemies keep their {{KW|Block}} ** [[Byrd|Byrds]] do not reset their {{BD|Flying}} and the [[Corrupt Heart]] does not reset its {{BD|Invincible}} * Anything that triggers, decreases, wears off or resets at the end of the round is skipped. ** {{BD|Frail}}, {{BD|Vulnerable}}, {{BD|Weak}} and {{BD|Lock-On}} do not decrease. ** {{BD|Blur}}, {{BD|Double Damage}}, {{BD|Equilibrium}}, {{BD|Intangible}}, and {{BD|No Block}} do not decrease, although their effects still apply as normal. ** {{BD|Draw Reduction}}, {{P|Duplication Potion}}, and {{BD|Wave of the Hand}} do not wear off, although their effects still apply as normal. ** A [[Cultist]]'s {{BD|Ritual}} and a [[Orb Walker]]'s {{BD|Strength Up}} do not trigger. ** {{BD|Malleable}} and {{BD|Slow}} do not reset. == Interactions == === Synergies === * Synergizes with {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Power|Powers}} that trigger every turn, for example {{C|Deva Form}}'s {{BD|Deva}} will scale. * Scales any {{C|Perseverance}}, {{C|Sands of Time}}, and {{C|Windmill Strike}} that is {{KW|Retain|Retained}}. * {{C|Vault}} can be used to negate the forced end of turn of {{BD|Time Warp}} if played as the 12th card, as well as the card limit of {{R|Velvet Choker}} or {{C|Normality}}. === Anti-Synergies === * Playing this card twice through an effect like {{C|Omniscience}} or a {{P|Duplication Potion}} will result in that effect being wasted, as the first copy played already ends your turn, preventing the second play. * {{BD|Draw Reduction}} applies but does not wear off, meaning playing {{C|Vault}} while having this debuff makes it affect you twice. * {{C|Blasphemy}}'s {{BD|Blasphemer}} will trigger immediately. == Update History == {{Update History Table/start}} {{Update History Table/row|Watcher 10|* Adding VFX for Vault card.}} {{Update History Table/row|Watcher 6|* Vault card description updated to clarify its effect.}} {{Update History Table/row|Watcher 5|* Reworked Vault card.}} {{Update History Table/row|Watcher 1|* Added Vault to the game ''(likely)''}} {{Update History Table/end}} {{WatcherNav}} wikitext:
{{Sequel Disambiguation}} {{Card Infobox | Name = Wraith Form | Image = Green-WraithForm.png | Color = Green | Type = Power | Rarity = Rare | Cost = 3 | Description = Gain (2;3) {{BD|Intangible}}.
At the end of your turn, lose 1 {{BD|Dexterity}}. | GivesToPlayer = Intangible, Wraith Form | PowerGives = Dexterity (Negative) }} {{Power Infobox|Intangible}} {{Power Infobox | Name = Wraith Form | Image = Icon WraithForm.png | Description = At the start of your turn, lose X {{BD|Dexterity}}. | Type = Debuff | Stacks = Intensity | BetweenTurns = | Cap = | GivesToPlayer = Dexterity (Negative) }} {{C|Wraith Form}} is a {{QueryLink|Cards|color:Green|Silent}} {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Rare|Rare}} {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Power|Power}} Card. It costs 3 {{Icon|GE}} Energy to play and provides the player with 2 (3) stacks of {{BD|Intangible}}. While the player has {{BD|Intangible}}, every instance of damage taken is reduced to 1. However, {{C|Wraith Form}} also afflicts the player with the {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff, which reduces the player's {{BD|Dexterity}} by 1 each turn for the remainder of combat or until the debuff is removed. == Synergies == === Cards === * The {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff can be prevented by gaining {{BD|Artifact}} through {{C|Core Surge}} or {{C|Panacea}}. See [[#Interactions|Interactions]] below. * {{BD|Dexterity}} sources such as {{C|Footwork}} and potentially {{C|Reprogram}} or {{C|Fasting}} can be used to temporarily counteract ongoing {{BD|Dexterity}} reduction from {{BD|Wraith Form}}. * {{BD|Intangible}} provided from {{C|Apparition}} will stack on top of any {{BD|Intangible}} gained through {{C|Wraith Form}}. * {{C|Wraith Form}} is a strong {{C|Nightmare}} target, giving the player access to substantially more stacks of {{BD|Intangible}}. However, playing '''X''' {{C|Wraith Form|Wraith Forms}} causes the {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff to stack, reducing '''X''' {{BD|Dexterity}} each turn. * {{C|Well-Laid Plans}} can be used to {{KW|Retain}} {{C|Wraith Form}} until an optimal turn, such as an especially high-damage enemy attack, to maximise damage reduction. * Self-damage cards such as {{C|Offering}} and {{C|Hemokinesis}} will only reduce the player's HP by 1 while {{BD|Intangible}} is active. === Relics === * {{R|Tungsten Rod}} reduces all HP loss to 0 while the player has {{BD|Intangible}}. * Sources of {{BD|Dexterity}} such as {{R|Kunai}} and to a lesser extent {{R|Oddly Smooth Stone}} can also counteract the {{BD|Dexterity}} loss induced by {{BD|Wraith Form}}. * The {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff can be '''entirely cleansed''' using {{R|Orange Pellets}}. Since {{C|Wraith Form}} is itself a Power, playing an Attack and a Skill the same turn as it will activate {{R|Orange Pellets}} and clear all debuffs, including {{BD|Wraith Form}}. * The {{BD|Artifact}} provided by {{R|Clockwork Souvenir}} at the start of combat can be used to nullify the {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff. Since the relic always activates at the very start of combat, its {{BD|Artifact}} will always nullify {{BD|Wraith Form}} entirely when {{C|Wraith Form}} is played instead of doing so for just one turn (see [[#Interactions|Interactions]]). === Potions === * {{P|Ancient Potion}} can provide {{BD|Artifact}}, which will nullify the {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff if used ''before'' {{C|Wraith Form}} is played (see [[#Interactions|Interactions]] below). * {{P|Dexterity Potion}} can temporarily counteract the {{BD|Dexterity}} loss induced by {{BD|Wraith Form}}. * {{P|Ghost in a Jar}} can also provide 1 stack of {{BD|Intangible}} (2 with {{R|Sacred Bark}}) which is additive with {{BD|Intangible}} gained from {{C|Wraith Form}}. === Power-based === Being a Power, it will: * '''Heal''' for '''2''' with {{R|Bird-Faced Urn}}. * Make a random card cost 0 temporarily with {{R|Mummified Hand}}. * Draw '''X''' cards with '''X''' stacks of {{C|Heatsinks}}. * Generate '''X''' {{Icon|LO}} '''Lightning Orbs''' with '''X''' stacks of {{C|Storm}}. == Interactions == === Artifacts === {{BD|Artifact}} can be used to prevent the {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff, but will only cleanse the debuff in full if acquired ''before'' {{C|Wraith Form}} is played. If '''X''' {{BD|Artifact}} is acquired ''after'' the player already has the {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff, the next '''X''' instances of {{BD|Dexterity}} loss will be prevented, but the debuff itself will not be cleansed. This interaction applies regardless of how {{BD|Artifact}} is gained, whether through cards, relics, or potions. === Thorns and Beat of Death === * While {{BD|Intangible}}, [[Corrupt Heart]]'s {{BD|Beat of Death}} deals only 1 damage each time a card is played. * [[Guardian]]'s {{BD|Sharp Hide}} and [[Shapes#Spiker|Spikers]]' {{BD|Thorns}} will only deal 1 damage while {{BD|Intangible}} is active. === Other sources of Intangible === Acquiring {{BD|Intangible}} through other means, such as {{C|Apparition}} or {{P|Ghost in a Jar}}, will increment {{BD|Intangible}} stacks provided by {{C|Wraith Form}} and vice versa. === Enemy intents === If an enemy is attacking while the player has {{BD|Intangible}}, their intent will be updated to show 1 damage per hit. Multi-hits will be converted to 1 times X damage, where X is the number of hits the enemy intends to inflict. === Sources of Block unaffected by Dexterity === The {{BD|Wraith Form}} debuff has no effect on sources of {{KW|Block}} that do not scale with {{BD|Dexterity}}. These include: * {{P|Block Potion}} * {{C|After Image}} * {{C|Feel No Pain}} * {{C|Mental Fortress}} * {{C|Nirvana}} * {{C|Like Water}} * {{KW|Frost|Frost Orbs}} * {{R|Ornamental Fan}} * {{R|Orichalcum}} * {{R|Anchor}}, {{R|Horn Cleat}}, and {{R|Captain's Wheel}}. == Trivia == * {{C|Wraith Form}}, {{C|Biased Cognition}}, and {{C|Fasting}} are the only Power cards in the game that afflict the player with a '''persistent''' debuff. {{C|Berserk|Berserk's}} {{BD|Vulnerable}} debuff is capped at 2 turns (1 if upgraded). * {{C|Wraith Form|Wraith Form's}} Beta Art was prominently featured on the [https://contentiongames.myshopify.com/products/slay-the-spire-beta-art-cards Beta Art expansion box] of [https://contentiongames.com/games/slay/ Slay the Spire: The Board Game]. {{SilentNav}} [[Category:Cards]]
